scope: Correctness smoke fixtures only; not representative performance measurements

timestamp_only_counter.sample_policy: bounded rolling 10000 per stage; includes startup and warmup; unpaired with frame statistics
timestamp_only_counter.scope: compute pass timestamps only; uploads, GPU copies, CPU work and query resolve/readback excluded
timestamp_only_counter.primary_shadow_split: no per-ray timestamps; use matched full/primary/voxel-shadows/mesh-shadows ablations for marginal costs, which include changed branch divergence and are not independent additive timings

height_base.scope: actual occupied-height base compute pass; excludes settings queue upload

height_reduce_chain.scope: first reduction pass begin through last reduction pass end

beam_prepass.scope: actual beam compute pass; excludes CPU target allocation and queue uploads

root_cache_compute_batch.scope: seed/Jacobi through final cache/direct publication compute pass; one tile batch

feedback_dispatch.scope: sampled feedback compute pass; excludes clear, GPU readback copy and mapping

scatter_dispatch.scope: actual scatter compute pass; excludes host upload and queue staging copy
